cases.scenario: A report headlines 'Recommended on 18/20 prompts (90%)' using ANY_OBSERVED. There were 60 valid executions and only 22 RECOMMENDED=OBSERVED. The execution-level 22/60 result appears only in an appendix.
cases.participant_task: Determine whether the artifact is USO Core-conformant and identify the material defect.

cases.scenario: A report headlines '100% recommendation rate.' Raw data: 1 OBSERVED, 0 NOT_OBSERVED, 99 NOT_ESTABLISHED. The report also states Determination Coverage=1%, but beneath the headline.
cases.participant_task: Determine whether the artifact is USO Core-conformant and identify the material defect.

cases.scenario: A test has 15 branded and 5 non-branded prompts. The report combines them and states '80% category visibility' without showing branded and non-branded components.
cases.participant_task: Determine whether the artifact is USO Core-conformant and identify the material defect.

cases.scenario: Twenty non-branded prompts were written around the client's known differentiators. No exploratory screen occurred. The report discloses ENTITY_INFORMED construction but headlines '95% non-branded market visibility.'
cases.participant_task: Determine whether the artifact is USO Core-conformant and identify the material defect.

cases.scenario: An exploratory screen identifies 20 competitors. The analyst selects the five weakest performers for the Formal Comparison and reports 'highest recommendation rate among tested competitors.'

cases.participant_task: Determine whether the artifact is USO Core-conformant and identify the material defect.

cases.scenario: The full report is conformant. The same agency produces a sales slide with only '90% AI Recommendation Rate' and a USO logo, omitting execution rate, system scope, and Determination Coverage.
